title: Vignette 2026-11-02: a website editor is a sub-domain; its statements are backed and must not drift from the core materials

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Owner, 2026-11-02, on the persona holding SP-140: "The persona for the website is probably not really a general editor. 
We are in a sub-domain of the general editor here. A website has it's own reasons to manage content with backup - but agents are able to write the copy in this view - but we just want to discourage it. A website editor needs to make clear statements that are backed up by evidence and other content. Often a website text is could be extracted from other materials. We will establish core marketing or argument materials and then the website needs to make sure its not makign different claims"

sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-11-02; recorded verbatim.
